finding: Commit 47618a65 adds to BR-113 the sentence that prepare-wave 'also skips an entry whose dependency inside the run is not done, names the dependency, and prepares the rest of the wave'. cmd_prepare_wave in packages/factory/scripts/dispatch names the dependency only when it lies in another wave. An entry whose dependency lies in the same wave is skipped without a message, because orchestrated prepare-story prepares it later as the next link of its serial chain. For example, wave 1 holds the chain ST-0350, ST-0351, and prepare-wave 1 prepares ST-0350 and prints nothing about ST-0351. Add one sentence to BR-113: prepare-wave skips an entry whose dependency lies in the same wave without a message, because prepare-story prepares it as the next link of the chain. Owner: domain-modeling-agent.
why_this_severity: The states after prepare-wave match BR-113, because the chain link stays pending and prepare-story prepares it as BR-113 says, so an implementer reaches the right behavior (no to fails_purpose); a test writer who asserts the message for a chain link must read the code to learn that none is printed (raises_cost).
